items.title: refactor(logging): reuse canonical file log serialization (#152082)
items.summary: refactor(logging): reuse canonical file log serialization (#152082) * refactor(logging): reuse canonical file log serialization Keep one redaction owner and skip the final parse/stringify when redaction leaves canonical file JSON unchanged. Preserve normalization for changed keys and UTF-16, object transport behavior, and single native-value conversion. Validated 318 focused tests, selected changed checks, byte-equivalence edge cases, registered logger branch activation, and independent review. Synthetic CPU comparison was inconclusive; no runtime speedup claim. * fix(logging): normalize native records without messages Reuse unchanged file bytes only when they come from serialization of the materialized tree. Metadata-only native output retains normalization after redaction, preserving key order and configured rules that inspect its original serialized context. Native values are still converted once. Add registered logger regressions for reversed integer-key output and a contextual masking rule. The byte-order case passes on historical production and fails on the original optimization. All 320 focused tests, complete selected checks, and fresh managed review passed. Six-case branch observation confirms ordinary byte reuse and historical normalization for the edge cases. The earlier CPU comparison remains inconclusive; no runtime speedup is claimed.

items.title: 美SEC開放股票上鏈交易，推出5年創新豁免
items.summary: 美國證券交易委員會（SEC）周四（9/17）宣布推出「創新豁免」（Innovation Exemption），允許符合條件的業者建立代幣化證券交易場所（Tokenized Securities Venue，TSV），利用自動做市商（Automated Market Maker，AMM）與流動性池（Liquidity Pool）機制，進行代幣化美國上市股票的鏈上交易。

items.title: Claude已主導Anthropic 26%的AI研發工作
items.summary: Anthropic周四（9/17）公布最新AI發展速度衡量研究，揭露截至今年8月，Claude已能主導Anthropic約26%的AI研發工作，達到「協作」以上程度的工作占比更超過90%。Anthropic同時提出一套衡量前沿AI發展速度的方法，涵蓋AI參與自身研發的程度、人類監督AI代理人的能力，以及研發算力配置等三大面向。

items.title: TWNIC籲企業將網域納入資安治理，臺灣DNSSEC部署率僅2.47%
items.summary: 隨著釣魚、假冒網站與網域挾持等威脅增加，台灣網路資訊中心（TWNIC）近日呼籲企業重新檢視網域與網站的基礎安全，並鼓勵企業利用TWNIC提供的網站健檢服務check.twnic.tw，進一步掌握自身網站與網域的防護狀況，特別是DNSSEC、RPKI及域名安全鎖（Registry Lock）等數位信任機制的部署情形。 TWNIC指出，企業過去談資安，多聚焦於防火牆、系統弱點與帳號安全，但隨著官方網站、電子郵件成為重要對外窗口，加上生成式AI降低假冒網站製作門檻，網域、DNS與路由等基礎設施也需要納入企業資安治理。
